filename: Microsoft Store Refund & Return Policy (Surface, Xbox, etc.).pdf

provenance.notes: Draft reference labels used for development suite validation; must be re-verified double-blind for Stage 4/5 certified benchmarks.

methodology: Pre-extraction independent human reading of PDF source bytes. Exhaustive enumeration of obligations, permissions, prohibitions, definitions, capabilities, and references.

claim_truth.subject: Customers
claim_truth.object: almost any physical product by January 31, 2027 for a full refund
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Don’t love it? Return almost any physical product by January 31, 2027, for a full refund. Some exclusions apply.

claim_truth.subject: Customers
claim_truth.object: in like-new condition in its original packaging with all parts and documentation included
claim_truth.section: How to start your free return
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Using the label, return the product in like-new condition in its original packaging with all parts and documentation included.

claim_truth.subject: Microsoft Store
claim_truth.object: refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days
conditions: Once we get the item back and confirm eligibility
claim_truth.section: How to start your free return
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Once we get the item back and confirm eligibility, we’ll issue a refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.

claim_truth.subject: Return process
claim_truth.object: 60 days after customer receives the product
conditions: For purchases made outside the window of October 1, 2026 – December 2, 2026
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Return process must be started within 60 days after customer receives the product.

claim_truth.subject: Product returns
claim_truth.object: 5 product returns per eligible customer purchase
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Limit 5 product returns per eligible customer purchase.

claim_truth.subject: Customers
claim_truth.object: Microsoft Store or a Microsoft Experience Center for price adjustments
conditions: Customer is eligible only if the product is in stock for purchase at Microsoft Store or a Microsoft Experience Center
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Customer is eligible only if the product is in stock for purchase at Microsoft Store or a Microsoft Experience Center. Customer must contact Microsoft Store or a Microsoft Experience Center

informational_truth.subject: Holiday extended return policy
informational_truth.content: Available with eligible physical products purchased between October 1, 2026 - December 2, 2026 from Microsoft Store online and Microsoft Experience Centers in select markets.
informational_truth.evidence_quote: Holiday extended return policy available with eligible physical products purchased between October 1, 2026 - December 2, 2026 from Microsoft Store online and Microsoft Experience Centers in select markets.
